title.narrative: From war to nature: engaging internally displaced people and local residents in environmental monitoring in Roztochya region, West Ukraine
From war to nature: engaging internally displaced people and local residents in environmental monitoring in Roztochya region, West Ukraine

description.narrative: Nature Reserve Roztochya will implement a 24-month project titled "From war to nature: engaging internally displaced people and local residents in environmental monitoring in Roztochia region, West Ukraine" The project aims to involve internally displaced people and local residents in monitoring biodiversity and environmental indicators in the region. The project will involve capacity building, awareness-raising campaigns, volunteer engagement, and the installation of monitoring equipment. The expected results include increased community involvement in environmental monitoring and improved conservation of biodiversity in the region.
